title: Modine Reinforces Commitment to Sustainability, Joins Department of Energy's Better Plants Program and Achieves Strong CDP and EcoVadis Ratings
summary: Modine (NYSE: MOD), a global leader in thermal management technology and solutions, today announced it has joined the U.S. Department of Energy's (DOE) Better Plants program, furthering its commitment to reducing energy intensity and promoting a more sustainable future. This initiative, combined with the company's recent strong performance in CDP and EcoVadis ratings, underscores Modine's dedication to environmental stewardship and its role in engineering a cleaner, healthier world by helping customers achieve their sustainability goals. In addition to this new partnership, Modine has also been recognized for its robust sustainability reporting and performance. The company recently achieved a B score for Climate Change and a B for Water Security in the 2025 CDP survey. CDP is a leading global non-profit that runs the world's environmental disclosure system for companies, cities, states, and regions. A 'B' score indicates that a company is taking coordinated action on climate issues.
